consumer: The offline map-dump writer reading the snapshot JSON, asking 'what is the raw authoritative terrain id at this tile?'
scope: Per-tile raw ground-truth terrain id over the exported nearby-tile region, independent of visibility/memory/display formatting
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles — its per-tile loop calls ctx.m.ter(p).id().str(), the raw map terrain query returning authoritative world state, not a computed predicate or display proxy
divergence: A tile the player has never seen (seen=false): a display/observability surface (class D) would report memory/unknown, but the raw map dump must still report the true underlying terrain id — the raw m.ter() query reports it correctly
